rules.action: Verify token validity, audience, issuer and minimum required scopes.
Verify host, private DNS, VPN, firewall and service availability.
Check documented role and scope requirements; request minimum permission.
Honor Retry-After, bounded exponential backoff and agreed quotas.
Correlate request IDs and timestamps; check upstream and gateway logs.
Measure latency and tune bounded timeout/deadline behavior.
Compare sanitized payload against the active contract.
Restore certificate verification and trust-chain configuration.
